title: Attack: a cross-model adversary for ledger entry UQ-20261030-04
statement: Within a single cell, is the number of de-novo somatic mutations carried by each individual near-full-length mtDNA molecule distributed as the Poisson expectation computed from that same cell's per-base de-novo mutation frequency times the called molecule length, or is it overdispersed - a minority of molecules carrying a disproportionate share of the cell's mutations, as a replication hierarchy among genome copies would produce?

inputs.read_only: the entry's fields from 'Question (canonical)' through the significance argument. Do NOT read its earlier adversary logs or verification notes before you finish: this unit exists to get an attack that was not anchored on them.
inputs.why: Provisional after three adversaries from one model family; a second family's attack is the cheapest independent check left.
